summary: Root marker collision: `reports_compare.go` keeps the document root as a distinct empty internal collection path and applies the human-readable `$` label only when formatting comparison output.
reason: `reports_compare.go` keeps the document root as a distinct empty internal collection path and applies the human-readable `$` label only when formatting comparison output. A JSON property literally named `$` therefore remains an ordinary key for collection kinds, member classification, and fixed metrics.
